title: Football Match Predictions: Probabilities vs Results
subtitle: Pre-match 1X2 probabilities of a Dixon-Coles model with final scores
description:
Every settled prediction of the Football Analytics model (https://footballanalytics.pro): for each finished match in a covered competition, the 1X2 probabilities the model stored before kick-off, its goal expectations, its pick, and the final score. Nothing is filtered by outcome, so the record can be checked and scored by anyone.

**Source and documentation:** https://footballanalytics.pro/en/data  
**Live track record:** https://footballanalytics.pro/en/performance  
**Daily-refreshed mirror:** GITHUB_URL

### Columns
- `fixture_id`: match identifier
- `kickoff_utc`: kick-off in UTC, ISO 8601
- `league`, `league_slug`, `country`: competition
- `home_team`, `away_team`: club names
- `home_score`, `away_score`: final goals after 90 minutes plus stoppage time
- `result`: 1 home win, X draw, 2 away win
- `p_home`, `p_draw`, `p_away`: model probabilities stored before kick-off (0-1)
- `lambda_home`, `lambda_away`: model goal expectation per side (Poisson rate)
- `pick`, `pick_correct`: the pre-match 1X2 pick and whether it came in
- `model_version`: model version of the row
- `match_url`: public match page

### Notes
- Settled matches only; upcoming predictions are not included.
- Goal expectations are Dixon-Coles / Poisson estimates, not shot-based xG.
- No bookmaker odds are included.
- Model output, not betting advice.
